task_name: Speed Up Planks, Collect Metal, Upgrade Residential Zone, and Queue Factory Materials

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When a residential zone requires 2 Planks to upgrade and the Building Supplies Store is crafting Planks.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Completing the Planks production and upgrading the residential zone adds +52 base population and keeps residential progression moving while factories switch back to a mix of Wood and Metal.
preconditions: Wood and Metal available for crafting
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Collect Planks from the Building Supplies Store, apply them to the residential zone, and refill all 5 Small Factories.

steps.briefing: speed up Nails with 2 SimCash, collect finished Planks, and drag Planks into the production slot.

steps.who: floating Metal on the northern Small Factories
steps.briefing: collect finished Metal from the factories.

steps.who: yellow hard hat on the left Residential Zone
steps.briefing: drag Planks (2/2) onto the zone to upgrade it.
drag Wood and Metal into the empty factory slots.
